title: REST is a PhD thesis, not a protocol
body: Roy Fielding's 2000 dissertation analysed why the Web scaled, and named its architectural style REST: stateless requests, uniform interfaces, cacheable responses. He had co-written the HTTP specification, so REST was a description of why the Web already worked, later applied, and often misapplied, to APIs everywhere.
source_hint: Fielding, 'Architectural Styles and the Design of Network-based Software Architectures' (2000)
